note: Arena building projects the owner can start. Costs are for a league with a $140M cap and scale with the cap. A project is paid up front, takes `seasons` season-ends to finish, and then applies its effect. Only one project of each kind can run at a time.

projects.name: Expand seating
projects.description: +1,500 seats (more tickets if there is demand, but more upkeep).

projects.name: Practice facility
projects.description: Players develop faster (+5 on the coaching rating of player development per level), up to 3 levels; each level costs upkeep every season.

projects.name: Medical center
projects.description: Injuries heal faster (6% shorter per level), up to 3 levels; each level costs upkeep every season.

projects.name: Luxury suites
projects.description: More arena event income (each level adds 25%), up to 3 levels.
